We need to propose retrosynthesis route to target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We have identified some building blocks that are buyable: sulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl: O=S(Cl)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1 (sulfonyl chloride). Also carbamate tertiary amine: O=C(OC(C)(C)C)N1CCNCC1 (actually we have O=C(OC(C)(C)C)N1CCNCC1? we checked O=C(N1CCN(C(=O)OC(C)(C)C)CC1)C which is a N-acyl piperazine? Wait we have is_buyable for O=C(N1CCN(C(=O)OC(C)(C)C)CC1)C (that's N-acyl piperazine with t-Bu carbamate). Also we have aromatic phenol with bromine and OH: Brc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O (bromo phenol fused with cyclohexane? Actually it's a brominated phenyl fused to cyclohexanol). Also Nc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O (aniline version). Also O=S(Cl)C1=CC=C(F)C=C1 (sulfonyl chloride). Also O=C(OC(C)(C)C)N1CCNCC1 (carbamate piperazine). Also O=S(Cl)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1 is same as earlier.

Goal: target is a sulfonamide linking sulfonyl group attached to fluorophenyl and to an aniline (aryl amine) that is part of a polycyclic aromatic system with a tertiary amine side chain bearing carbamate.

We can think retrosynthesis: disconnection at sulfonamide bond: use sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) + aniline (aryl amine). So step 1: sulfonylation of aniline with sulfonyl chloride.

Thus precursors: aryl sulfonyl chloride (O=S(Cl)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1) and aniline (NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1). Need to see if aniline is commercially available. We checked earlier not buyable. So need to further break down aniline.

Aniline part: core polycyclic aromatic (maybe a benzofuran-like) with a side chain N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2 attached via an aniline nitrogen (aryl amine). So we can think of forming C-N bond via Buchwald-Hartwig amination between aryl bromide (or aryl chloride) and piperazine carbamate.

We have a brominated version Brc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O which is buyable. That is a bromophenol fused with cyclohexanol? Actually structure: bromophenyl fused to cyclohexanol (maybe similar to our core). Our target core is Nc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O (aniline version). So we can get that via Buchwald amination of Brc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O with piperazine carbamate (the amine). The piperazine carbamate is N-(tert-butoxycarbonyl)piperazine? Actually O=C(OC(C)(C)C)N1CCNCC1 is a carbamate of piperazine (N-Boc piperazine). But our target side chain is N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2 attached via the nitrogen to the aromatic ring (aryl amine). That is a secondary amine (aryl attached to piperazine nitrogen). The piperazine nitrogen bearing the carbamate is the other nitrogen. So we need a piperazine with one nitrogen protected (carbamate) and the other free to couple.

Thus we can use N-Boc-piperazine (O=C(OC(C)(C)C)N1CCNCC1) as a nucleophile after deprotonation? Actually Buchwald amination uses aryl halide + secondary amine (piperazine). So we need N-Boc-piperazine (one nitrogen protected) which is commercially available (we have is_buyable true). So step 2: Buchwald-Hartwig coupling of Brc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O with N-Boc-piperazine to give Nc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O attached to piperazine (with Boc on other N). That yields the aniline part (with Boc). Then step 3: deprotect Boc (remove protecting group) to give free secondary amine (aryl attached to piperazine). However our target has the carbamate attached to the piperazine nitrogen (C(OC(C)(C)C)=O). That's a carbamate (tert-butyl carbamate) attached to the nitrogen that is attached to the aromatic? Wait target: N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2 attached to aromatic via N (the other nitrogen). Let's parse: N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2 is piperazine where one nitrogen is attached to aromatic (as part of aniline) and the other nitrogen is carbamated (tert-butoxy carbonyl). So indeed we need N-Boc-piperazine where Boc is on the nitrogen that will be carbamated (the one not attached to aromatic). After coupling, the Boc remains on that nitrogen, which matches target (carbamate). So we don't need deprotection; we need the Boc to stay. Good.

Thus step 2 yields final aniline precursor ready for sulfonylation.

Thus overall route:

Step 1: Sulfonylation: React aryl sulfonyl chloride (O=S(Cl)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1) with the aniline (product of step 2) to give target sulfonamide.

Step 2: Buchwald-Hartwig amination: Brc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O + N-Boc-piperazine -> Nc1ccc2c(c1)CCCC2O attached to piperazine (Boc protected). This yields the aniline precursor.

Thus total steps = 2. Leaves are commercially available: sulfonyl chloride, brominated phenol, N-Boc-piperazine. Need to verify all are buyable (we have yes). Also need to ensure price total < $9999. Likely.

We need to provide JSON route with type mol root target, children reaction nodes etc.

We need template IDs for reactions. We need to search for appropriate templates: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide (sulfonylation). Also Buchwald-Hartwig amination (aryl halide + secondary amine). Let's search.
